C0256.title: How to Avoid Infringement with Clips and Reposts? Ten Typical Short-Video Copyright Cases Explained
C0256.summary: In April 2022, the Beijing Internet Court released ten typical cases involving short-video copyright. Data shows that the majority of the 2,633 sued infringements were reproduction-based, primarily involving clipping long videos, reposting short videos, and adding background music.
